meta.title: Get Notes Organizer
meta.description: Installed Cordis bundle: organize 得到大脑/Get笔记 via official OpenAPI. Full-text download into a configurable data directory, read-only by default, confirmation-gated writes, double-gated deletion. Configure API Key/Client ID in the Settings → Getnote sidebar (see getnote/README.md §9); restart the app after changes.
